protocol: one full conversion per revision/dataset; three alternating independent read rounds; all reads bounded/streaming
cache_state: not purged or controlled; source/output hashes read complete files; no guarantee of page-cache residency for these large pairs
resident_read: not run: retaining complete expanded clouds would put pressure on available RAM; progressive and XYZ discard blocks
disk_basis: logical lengths and Linux st_blocks*512 per file on local Btrfs; not device-wide usage or transferable remote size
